aspects.description: Project files are organised with clear separation of concerns (markup, styles, scripts, assets)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and assets are in clearly separated files or folders, not mixed into a single unstructured file.

aspects.description: All 3 pages include the provided favicon
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Home, About, and Contact each include a favicon from assets/img/favicon-dark/ or assets/img/favicon-light/.

aspects.description: Copyright year in footer is set dynamically with JavaScript
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the footer copyright year equals the current calendar year and is written by JavaScript, not a hardcoded year alone.

aspects.description: Code quality — clean, well-structured, consistent naming and indentation
judgementScoreDescription: Code is messy, inconsistent indentation, no structure
Some structure but inconsistent naming or formatting
Excellent — clean, readable, well-organised code throughout

aspects.description: Valid HTML5 (no errors in W3C validator) - ignore warnings
aspects.extraDescription: Test: run the W3C Markup validator on all pages. Pass if there are 0 errors. Warnings may be ignored.

aspects.description: Valid CSS3 (no errors in W3C validator) - ignore warnings
aspects.extraDescription: Test: run the W3C CSS validator on the project stylesheets. Pass if there are 0 errors. Warnings may be ignored.

aspects.description: Border radius follows the 4px sharp-corner design token, except intentional circles/icons
aspects.extraDescription: Test: buttons, cards, inputs, and similar boxes use 4px radius. Circular icon badges and similar round elements may stay round.

aspects.description: Sufficient colour contrast — no WAVE contrast errors on any page
aspects.extraDescription: Test: run WAVE Contrast on Home, About, and Contact. Pass if there are 0 contrast errors on every page.

aspects.description: ARIA labels present on interactive elements (navigation, buttons, form controls, social/icon links)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: navigation links, buttons, form controls, and social/icon-only links have an accessible name (visible text, aria-label, or equivalent).

aspects.description: Active page in navigation is visually indicated and not a link
aspects.extraDescription: Test: on each page the current nav item is visually distinct from the others and is not an anchor to the same page.

aspects.description: Sticky header — fixed on scroll, white background, logo left, nav right
aspects.extraDescription: Test: scroll the Home page. The header stays fixed, has a white background and subtle shadow, with the logo on the left and Home/About/Contact on the right.

aspects.description: Hero — video background plays and loops
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the hero uses a full-screen video background that plays and loops without requiring user interaction.

aspects.description: Hero — dark overlay over video with sufficient contrast for white text
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a dark overlay sits over the hero video so heading and paragraph text remain readable.

aspects.description: Hero — rotating text animation cycles through 3 words with vertical slide
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the hero heading cycles Medicine → Food → Parcels with a vertical slide-up animation.

aspects.description: Hero — two buttons side by side (primary filled + outline)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Get Started is a primary filled button linking to Contact; Learn More is an outline light button linking to About; they sit side by side.

aspects.description: All buttons use left-to-right fill sweep animation on hover
aspects.extraDescription: Test: hover several buttons (hero, CTA, and at least one other page). A left-to-right fill sweep plays and the colours invert.

aspects.description: Features — 6 cards in 3-column grid
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the Features section shows 6 cards in a 3-column grid on desktop, with the headings from the brief (15-Minute Delivery through Live Tracking).

aspects.description: Features — cards have gradient rounded-square icons
aspects.extraDescription: Test: each feature card has a rounded-square icon on a primary-to-accent gradient background.

aspects.description: Features — card hover: lift, shadow, accent bottom border, icon scale
aspects.extraDescription: Test: hover a feature card. It lifts, the shadow deepens, an accent bottom border appears, and the icon scales up.

aspects.description: Stats — parallax background image with dark overlay
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the Stats section uses a CSS parallax background (parallax-sky.jpg or equivalent) with a dark overlay.

aspects.description: Stats — 4 counters animate from 0 to target on scroll
aspects.extraDescription: Test: scroll the Stats section into view. Four numbers animate from 0 to their targets with an eased motion.

aspects.description: Stats — numbers have gradient text fill (white to accent)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: stat numbers use a gradient text fill from white to accent.

aspects.description: Stats — glass-effect cards with semi-transparent background
aspects.extraDescription: Test: each of the four stats sits in a semi-transparent glass-style card.

aspects.description: How It Works — 4 step cards with gradient top border
aspects.extraDescription: Test: four step cards sit in a row on a light background, each with a gradient accent bar on the top edge.

aspects.description: How It Works — numbered circles with gradient and shadow
aspects.extraDescription: Test: each step has a numbered circle with a primary-to-accent gradient and a drop shadow.

aspects.description: How It Works — cards lift on hover
aspects.extraDescription: Test: hover a How It Works card; it lifts.

aspects.description: CTA — gradient background with decorative translucent circles
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the CTA section uses a primary-dark → primary → accent gradient and decorative translucent circles in the background.

aspects.description: CTA — frosted-glass icon badge above heading
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a frosted-glass icon badge (fa-paper-plane) is centred above the CTA heading.

aspects.description: Footer — light logo, description, 4 social icons, 3 link columns
aspects.extraDescription: Test: footer background is #1a1a2e. Column 1 has the light logo, description, and X/LinkedIn/Instagram/Facebook icons. Columns 2–4 are Company, Services, and Legal with headings and link lists.

aspects.description: Footer — social icons use platform brand colours on hover (X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: hover each social icon. Colours match X #000000, LinkedIn #0a66c2, Instagram #e4405f, Facebook #1877f2.

aspects.description: Overall visual accuracy to the provided mockup
judgementScoreDescription: Major sections missing or unrecognisable from mockup
Layout roughly matches but significant spacing, colour, or styling differences
Good match with minor inconsistencies in spacing or details
Near-identical to mockup — colours, spacing, typography, and effects all match

aspects.description: Page hero — gradient background with decorative circles
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the About page hero has a gradient background and decorative circles.

aspects.description: Page hero — icon badge and breadcrumb navigation
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the About hero includes a frosted icon badge (fa-rocket) and a breadcrumb (Home / About).

aspects.description: Mission section — two-column layout (image left, text right)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Mission is two columns on desktop: image on the left, text on the right.

aspects.description: Mission section — floating stat overlay card on image
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a floating stat overlay card sits on the Mission image.

aspects.description: Mission section — tag label above heading, accent underline on heading
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a tag label sits above the Mission heading, and the heading has an accent underline.

aspects.description: Values section — parallax background with dark overlay
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Values uses a dark parallax background with an overlay.

aspects.description: Values section — 3 value cards with icons
aspects.extraDescription: Test: three value cards are present with icons and the headings Safety First, Sustainability, and Community.

aspects.description: Team section — 3 member cards with photos, names, titles
aspects.extraDescription: Test: three team cards show a photo, name, and title each.

aspects.description: CTA section present and styled consistently with home page
aspects.extraDescription: Test: About includes a CTA section that matches the Home CTA (gradient, decorative circles, badge, outline button).

aspects.description: Design consistency and creative interpretation of wireframe
judgementScoreDescription: No visual relationship to the home page or brand
Some brand colours used but layout or styling inconsistent
Consistent with home page, minor creative gaps
Strong creative interpretation — feels like the same designer built both pages

aspects.description: Contact page design is visually consistent with Home/About brand system
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Contact uses the same colours, radius, typography, and header/footer language as Home and About.

aspects.description: Contact details displayed (address, email, phone, hours)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the page shows the Head Office address, email addresses, phone number, and operations hours from assets/texts.txt.

aspects.description: Contact form with all required fields (first_name, last_name, email, phone, subject dropdown with the six options listed in the brief, message)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: the form includes First Name, Last Name, Email, optional Phone, Subject dropdown (Request a Demo, Pricing & Plans, Partnership Enquiry, Technical Support, Press & Media, Other), Message, and Submit.

aspects.description: Form validates required fields with visual error feedback
aspects.extraDescription: Test: submit with required fields empty. Invalid fields show a visible error state. Phone may stay empty.

aspects.description: Form validates email format
aspects.extraDescription: Test: enter an invalid email (for example 'not-an-email') with other required fields filled. The email field shows a visible error and the form does not succeed.

aspects.description: Form success state on submission
aspects.extraDescription: Test: submit valid data. A success state is shown (message, replacement panel, or equivalent). No backend is required.

aspects.description: Map with location present
aspects.extraDescription: Test: a map (embed, image, or equivalent) representing the Head Office location is visible on the Contact page.

aspects.description: Social media links present
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Contact includes social links for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, and Facebook.

aspects.description: CTA section and footer present
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Contact includes a CTA section and a footer consistent with the other pages.

aspects.description: Overall design quality — layout, spacing, visual consistency with other pages
judgementScoreDescription: Basic layout but visually disconnected from other pages
Good design with consistent brand feel, minor issues

aspects.description: Mobile hamburger navigation menu functional
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 480px width, a hamburger control opens and closes the navigation and the links work.

aspects.description: Home page layout is usable at 1024px (desktop; must still scale cleanly on larger/4K screens)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 1024px width, Home has no horizontal overflow and sections remain readable. Widen toward a large/4K window: the desktop layout continues to scale without clipping.

aspects.description: Home page layout is usable at 768px
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 768px width, Home has no horizontal overflow and content remains usable. Compare with assets/samples/768px.png if helpful.

aspects.description: Home page layout is usable at 480px
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 480px width, Home has no horizontal overflow and content remains usable. Compare with assets/samples/480px.png if helpful.

aspects.description: About page layout is usable at 1024px (desktop; must still scale cleanly on larger/4K screens)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 1024px width, About has no horizontal overflow. Widen toward a large/4K window: the desktop layout continues to scale without clipping.

aspects.description: About page layout is usable at 768px
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 768px width, About has no horizontal overflow and content remains usable.

aspects.description: About page layout is usable at 480px
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 480px width, About has no horizontal overflow and content remains usable.

aspects.description: Contact page layout is usable at 1024px (desktop; must still scale cleanly on larger/4K screens)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 1024px width, Contact has no horizontal overflow. Widen toward a large/4K window: the desktop layout continues to scale without clipping.

aspects.description: Contact page layout is usable at 768px
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 768px width, Contact has no horizontal overflow and content remains usable.

aspects.description: Contact page layout is usable at 480px
aspects.extraDescription: Test: at 480px width, Contact has no horizontal overflow and content remains usable.
